name: SVG text metrics
plain: Measures SVG text extents and glyph positions.
meaning: SVG layout uses a separate text path from HTML, so metrics add fonts and rasterizer detail even under HTML-layout defenses.

limits.headline: Can measure picture text sizes to learn about your fonts and system
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Measure how wide and tall text drawn in pictures is
Learn font and drawing differences even when normal text checks are blocked
Add that number to a device profile
cannot: Show you anything on the screen
Know who you are by itself

story.what_it_is: A script measures the exact size and spacing of text drawn as an SVG graphic.

marketing.name: SVG text
marketing.pitch: Describes how SVG text works and which measuring tools sites can use to lay it out.

story.for_you: You never see it. The page draws text as a vector picture and measures where each letter lands. Those numbers vary with your fonts and system.
story.for_makers: Chart and map makers need these numbers to place labels. Trackers use the same numbers as another way to see your fonts and rendering, even when other methods are blocked.

use_cases.example: A charting site like a dashboard tool places labels on a graph by measuring each text label first.
A web map measures place names to avoid overlapping labels on your screen.
A web drawing tool with text on curves measures each letter to place it along a path.
A tracker draws text in SVG and records exact widths, which works even if canvas is blocked.
A fraud tool compares SVG text size to what the device claims, to find a spoofed setup.
An interactive science page labels diagram parts and measures text to avoid overlap.
A web strategy game places unit names on a map and measures them so they do not collide.

risks: Hard to block without breaking charts
